messages:
maria: Greenline just escalated increased p99 tail on their dedicated pool — SLA at risk if we don't land a short-term mitigation today. They see spikes when bursts hit model-quantized-v2. Can eng-platform + eng-sre sync on an immediate owner + plan?

 tom: I'm oncall. Seeing correlated queue growth on pool-dedicated-7; a few nodes hitting long GC-like stalls or GPU queueing. Suggest routing their traffic to quantized-v1 fallback for the next 2h while we investigate. Thoughts?

 asha: customer-success here: Greenline will accept a scheduled maintenance window but wants minimal disruption. If we route to v1, keep the interface identical — they care about latency, not small quality diffs.

 liam: eng-ml: quantized-v1 is compatible for chat endpoints, ~2% lower quality on some prompts but should reduce per-token latency and memory pressure. I can sign off on fallback. Need routing rule change + canary first.

 jen: eng-runtime: I can push a traffic-split rollback in console — create rule to route 90% -> v1, 10% -> v2 for 30m, then full cut if stable. Will need a PR for infra change and a 5m deploy. I'll open PR now.

 maria: owners: jen for shortfix, tom for oncall monitoring, liam for model signoff, asha for customer comms. Milestones: canary in 30m, full fallback in 60m if canary is fine. Track here and update.

 jen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8242 — adds dynamic-routing override for customer_id=greenline, supports traffic_split. Reviews: @maria @tom please. CI is quick. Adding canary flag + TTL.

 maria: pinging reviewers. Tom can you watch latency metrics and have rollback plan? Use dash.redwood/pool-dedicated-7 filter greenline_customer route.

 tom: watching. Setting alert: p99 > 1.8s -> rollback. Enabling debug tracing for 5m to capture queue histograms. Will post updates.

 liam: if routing causes error rate spike we should fallback to hosted-general as last resort (requires auth token switch + rate cap). Draft policy:

 ```
 if(p99 > 1.8s || errorRate > 0.5%) {
   route -> hosted-general (max qps 30)
   notify: #eng-oncall, #customer-success
 }
 ```

 jen: added TTL on routing rule + manual rollback button. Safety: only one customer override per pool.

 asha: I'll message Greenline: "We're initiating a controlled fallback to performance-focused quantized-v1 for 30-60 minutes while we stabilize. Minimal quality impact expected; we'll notify if anything changes." Will wait to send after canary OK.

 maria: ops checklist: jen create canary (in progress); tom monitor p99 + rollback alerts (in progress); liam model signoff + hosted fallback policy (in progress); asha customer comms (waiting canary); oncall: be ready to scale pool or evict low-priority tenants if needed.

 jen: canary live (flag=greenline-canary) 10% -> quantized-v1, observing baseline.

 tom: canary start 2467890200. p50/p90 stable, p99 dropped ~30% in first 4m. No errors. Holding 10% for 15m then bump to 90% if no regressions.

 liam: good. Running quick prompt sweep against v1 to validate edge cases. If regressions pop, will list them for per-route exclusions.

 maria: if canary hits rollback threshold we revert and escalate to eng-runtime for runtime profiling. If passes we proceed 90% -> 100% in next 30m.

 jen: bumped to 90% at 2467890500. PR merged. TTL set for 2h. Manual rollback enabled.

 tom: monitoring update: p99 at 2467890560 = 1.2s, error rate 0.03%. No GC stalls observed. CPU/GPU utilization redistributed within limits.

 asha: Greenline ack: "Thanks — canary looks good on our side. Please proceed with full switch but notify 10m before final cut." I'll send after 20m stable.

 maria: keeping thread for status. If anything changes post short updates here. We'll open follow-up ticket to root-cause the v2 regression (suspect kernel scheduling or memory leak).

 liam: creating ticket https://issues.redwood/INFER-4821 — including traces + prompt cases; assigned eng-runtime + eng-ml. ETA initial triage EOD.

 deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: platform-routing-service @prod (commit 9c4b1f) — rollout complete to pool-dedicated-7

 tom: final check 2467890860: p99 stable at 1.15s, error rate 0.02%. Mitigation successful. Moving to postmortem + permanent fix planning.

 maria: thanks team. I'll draft incident summary and owners for the permanent patch. asha please send Greenline a short note with timeline + next steps."
